DMG - Volume 10: Benefits for incapacity, 

disability, maternity, bereavement, and widows Chapters 55 - 63
DMG Memo 02/26: giving guidance on the 2026 Up-rating Amendment to paragraph 60051
Following changes have been made to include the DMG 05-25 Uprating Memo:
Minor amendment made to DMG chapter 61 paragraph 61461, 1.1.2
New DMG memo 12-25: Cross-Border Issues and Devolved Benefits added with cross references to the DMG chapters 60 and 61 paragraphs 60025, 60062 and 61015.

Unfortunately, Appendix 1 unexplainably disappeared from this chapter. It has now 

been reinstated.

Which has been amended to include changes set out in DMG Memo 06/25. Changes have 
been made to paragraphs 61461, 61466, 61568, 61558, 61581, 61583 and 61584.
Minor re-numbering amendments have been made to paragraphs 63052 to read 63051 and 63049 to read 63052
Minor amendments have been made to paragraph 616350 and a new heading at paragraph 61620.
DMG Memo 07-25 has been fully incorporated and is now deleted.

Incorporated “DMG Memo 02-23 - The Bereavement Benefit (Remedial) Order 2023 - Widowed Parent's Allowance and Higher Rate Bereavement Support Payment” into the chapter. Please be aware that this change has involved renumbering paragraphs 59001, 59003, 59007-8, 59011, 59018-59023, 59032-33, 59051, 59071-72 and the addition of Appendix 1.
Amendments have been made to incorporate DMG Memo 07-25: ADHD and SMI. Amendments have largely been made to paragraphs 61359 and 61360.

“DMG Memo 02-23 - The Bereavement Benefit (Remedial) Order 2023 - Widowed Parent's Allowance and Higher Rate Bereavement Support Payment” and “DMG Memo 09-23 Change to Underlying Entitlement Conditions for Widowed Parent's Allowance due to the Introduction of the Bereavement Benefits (Remedial) Order 2023” Incorporated into the chapter. Renumbering of paragraphs required and insertion of term ‘cohabiting partner’ where required affecting paragraphs 63017, 63019, 63022, 63023, 63026, 63030, 63035-63072,

63088-63090. Please be aware that this change has involved renumbering paragraphs and the addition of Appendix 1– The Bereavement Benefits (Remedial) Order – Widowed Parent’s Allowance and Higher Rate Bereavement Benefit.
DMG Memo 09-23 is now deleted as it’s been fully incorporated into the DMG.
Amendments made to various paragraphs 62017 - 62582 Addition of The Social Security (Class 2 National Insurance Contributions Increase of Threshold) Regulations 2022 No.1329 to SI abbreviations.
New 07-25: DLA: ADHD and severe mental impairment – Effect of Upper
Tribunal Decision: and uprating. Amendments to paras.: 61255, 61350, 61351, 61352, 61355, 61359, 61360, 61376, 61377, 61618
Also please note additions to DMG SI abbreviations added which are - SMI Severe Mental Impairment and ADHD Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder.

Amendment made DMG paragraph 62534: Calculating Earnings of employees – 

Number 11 added to list to include statutory neonatal care pay due to amendment to reg 2 (1) of the MA (Earnings) Regs 2000 by The Neonatal Care Leave and Pay (Consequential Amendments to Subordinate Legislation) Regulations 2025. Legal reference added.

DMG Memo 06-25: Legacy Benefits and State Pension Credit - The Social Security (Scotland) Act 2018 (Disability Assistance) (Consequential Amendments) Order 2025, added with cross references to the DMG Abbreviations, Statutes & S.I. lists plus DMG chapters 61, 35, Vol 1 Annex A, 02, 04, 03, 04, 53, 23, 41, 44, 78, 20, 28 & 86
New DMG Memo 5/25: and uprating amendment to para. 60051
DMG Memo 12/23 incorporated at paragraphs 63064 and 63069 - addition of CSP where CA is mentioned in paragraphs.
DMG Memos 04/23 and 02/24 incorporated at paragraph 60061.
Amended para 61342 to remove out of date contact details for DMA.

Note under para 62524 to provide greater clarity within guidance about the Earnings Test and specifically about the fact that whilst a woman doesn’t have to have received a payment in each of the chosen 13 weeks within her Test Period, they need to have earned an amount equal to the MAT (when averaged) for each of those 13 weeks – irrespective of when the payment is made.
Para. 62017 amended to give example of certificate of confinement (MATB1) and para. 62020 changed to clarify the types of evidence required for stillbirth.
Note 2 added to para. 62516 for clarification regarding zero hours contracts and agency workers.

Amendment to paras. 62540 and 62541 to show that for women who have not paid their NICS to qualify for the standard rate of MA the legislation does clearly indicate that they should be treated as receiving earnings equal to the MAT (£30) for that week. At present the fact that this relates to each individual week isn’t clear.

Para. 62524 – legislative reference amended from ‘SS (MA) (Earnings) Regs, reg 6(1)’ to ‘SS (MA) (Earnings) Regs, reg 6(1)(b)’. Additional note added “Note: The position differs for the self-employed (see DMG 62540)”.

Added para. 62545 ‘Payment of class 2 contributions treated as paid’ due to legislation introduced by The Social Security (Class 2 National Insurance Contributions Increase of Threshold) Regulations 2022.
Numbers changed at paras. 62546 to 62552 due to addition of para. 62545.

Para. 62025 – removal of sentence - “If, as a result of this calculation, disallowance would be appropriate because the length of pregnancy falls short of a full 24 weeks by one week or less, the case should be referred to Medical Services for advice.”
Updated Appendix 1 – earnings limit for gainful employment.
Updated Appendix 3 – rates of benefit (AA) and Appendix 4 – rates of benefit (DLA).
incorporate DMG Memo 2-17. That Memo is also deleted from the Memo list.

Note added below para. 61491 to advise change of terminology for terminal illness to 

end of life in operations/comms.

Amendment 1 in Qualifying Period – Disability Living Allowance - DLA Care 

Component at 61461 1.2 addition of CDP care component x2 into following sentence:

1.2 ending on the day the person was last entitled to AA, the DLA care 

component or the CDP care component, and that day is not more than two years before the date on which the award of the DLA care component or the CDP care component would begin3and

Amendment 2 in Qualifying Period – Disability Living Allowance - DLA Mobility 

Component at 61466 1.2a and 1.2b addition of CDP mobility component x2 into following sentences:

1.2.a when the person was last entitled to the DLA mobility component 

or the CDP mobility component and

1.2.b which cannot be more than two years before the date on which 

the award of the DLA mobility component or the CDP mobility component would begin2and
Paragraph 60033 has been updated to refer to equivalent benefits from an EU member state “the definition of a severely disabled person” (Memo DMG 02/20 incorporated.)

Paragraphs 60025 – 60081 has been updated 'Conditions for entitlement to 

Carer’s Allowance’ at Meaning of severely disabled person - 60033.  Addition of 

legal reference, equivalent benefit from an EU member state’ and correct citation inserted into legal references.

Appendix 1 - Earnings limit for gainful employment.  DMG Memos 3/19, 5-20, 4/21, 7-22 

incorporated - Amounts added for tax years from 9.4.18 to 11.4.22 to list (amended previous amount that was incorrect for period 9.4.18 – 7.4.19)
Amendment in 'Conditions for entitlement to Carers Allowance 60025 – 60081’ at meaning of severely disabled person - 60033.  Addition of ADP on list at number 7 and relevant legal references.
Amendment in 'Conditions for entitlement to Carers Allowance paras. 60025 – 60081’ at Meaning of severely disabled person - 60033.  Addition of CDP on list at number 6.
